3-3-25
Claim opened for a parking lot collision in which the insured's vehicle was strcuk while stopped. The claimant reports
a back strain and is represented by counsel, so all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
3-24-25
Confirmed that the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was in force at the time of the loss. Nothing in the
file suggests the damage predates the poilcy period.
5-8-25
Reviewed photographs submitted by the insured. They confirm several detalis of the scene, though no independent
witnesses have come forward. The damage to the vehicle appears consistent with the impact described in the report.
8-23-25
Police reocrds and statements from other parties confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time. The claimant
has given the same account of events in every conversation so far. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known from
prior claims or inspection records.
8-27-25
Medical records received. The reported back injury fits the kind and force of the collision. No prior injury to the same
area appears in the records. Treatment followed a typical course and tapered off as the claimnat improved.
8-30-25
Reviewed the file and the medical timeline with the claim supervisor. The injury, vehicle damage, and account are
consistent with one another, and no evidence has been found that points away from the reported loss. Claim remains
open pending final bills from the treating provider.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
